name: kit-boot
about: LumaKit's calls that read the running game (camera.now, pointer.world, pointer.screen, item.give coins and health, cutscene.active) at boot frame 1, with no scene, no player and no camera: each returns and the game goes on, camera.now()'s eye is the empty vector; on the stage the same calls return and the eye is the camera's. Before M2 the first ended the game
